<style id="pando-v9-style">/* Pando site v9-2026-10-27 */

/* ── Layout concept: one dark world, the Brain. A 3D halo of notes is the stage for every section;
      HTML carries every word. Ink is white; agent colours appear only on agent identity. ── */
:root{
  --bg:#050506;--bg2:#08080a;--p0:#0a0a0d;--p1:#0d0d10;--p2:#121216;--p3:#18181d;--p4:#202027;
  --line:rgba(255,255,255,.07);--line2:rgba(255,255,255,.12);--line3:rgba(255,255,255,.2);
  --ink:#f3f3f5;--ink2:#bdbdc6;--ink3:#92929c;--ink4:#64646d;
  --claude:#d97757;--codex:#10a37f;--cursor:#c9ced6;--grok:#e6e6e6;
  --ok:#62d195;--warn:#e8925b;--bad:#ff6f6f;
  --display:"Jost",-apple-system,"Helvetica Neue",system-ui,sans-serif;
  --sans:var(--display);
  /* outline lettering keeps Network's serif: Jost's overlapping contours show through a stroke */
  --serif:"Instrument Serif","Iowan Old Style","Palatino Linotype",Georgia,serif;
  --em:#8b8f9b;
  --mono:"Google Sans Code",ui-monospace,"SF Mono",Menlo,Consolas,monospace;
  --maxw:1320px;
  color-scheme:dark;
}
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box}
/* the live host loads a CSS reset and utility classes (Tailwind); put back the browser defaults this page was designed on */
body p{margin-block:1em}
body small{font-size:smaller}
body svg,body canvas{display:inline;vertical-align:baseline}
body img,body video{vertical-align:baseline}
html,body{height:auto!important}
html{background:var(--bg);-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font:400 17px/1.6 var(--sans);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;-moz-osx-font-smoothing:grayscale;text-rendering:optimizeLegibility}
.pando-static-page{font-family:var(--sans)}
html.lenis,html.lenis body{height:auto}
.lenis.lenis-smooth{scroll-behavior:auto!important}
.lenis.lenis-smooth [data-lenis-prevent]{overscroll-behavior:contain}
.lenis.lenis-stopped{overflow:hidden}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
img,video{max-width:100%;display:block}
button{font:inherit;color:inherit;background:none;border:0;padding:0;cursor:pointer}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #fff;outline-offset:3px;border-radius:6px}
[data-audos-crawler-snapshot="1"]{display:none!important}
.sr{position:absolute!important;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0 0 0 0);white-space:nowrap}
.skip{position:fixed;left:16px;top:-60px;z-index:100;background:#fff;color:#000;padding:10px 14px;border-radius:8px;font-weight:600}
.skip:focus{top:16px}

/* ── stage: poster + WebGL ── */
.gl-on .poster{display:none}
.poster{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:0;background:#050506 url(data:image/jpeg;base64,) center/cover no-repeat;opacity:.9;pointer-events:none}
#gl{position:fixed;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;z-index:0;opacity:0;transition:opacity 1s ease;pointer-events:none}
#gl.on{opacity:1}
.chips{position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;overflow:hidden}
#chipsB{z-index:1}
.chip{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;transition:opacity .3s;padding:5px 10px 5px 7px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(14,14,17,.92);border:1px solid var(--line2);font:500 11.5px/1 var(--sans);color:var(--ink);white-space:nowrap;will-change:transform,opacity;opacity:0}
.chip i{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--c);box-shadow:0 0 10px var(--c)}
.chip img{width:13px;height:13px}
.nlab{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;pointer-events:none;opacity:0;will-change:transform,opacity}
.nlab .d{position:absolute;left:-3px;top:-3px;width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(255,255,255,.9)}
.nlab .l{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.5),rgba(255,255,255,.08));transform-origin:0 0}
.nlab .t{position:absolute;white-space:nowrap;font:500 11.5px/1.35 var(--mono);color:var(--ink);padding:6px 9px;border:1px solid var(--line2);background:rgba(10,10,13,.86);border-radius:7px}
.nlab .t small{display:block;color:var(--ink3);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:2px}

/* ── preloader ── */
#pre{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:90;background:var(--bg);display:grid;place-items:center;pointer-events:none}
html:not(.js) #pre,.nofx #pre{display:none}
#pre .in{display:grid;justify-items:center;gap:18px}
#pre svg.pre-ring{width:180px;height:62px;overflow:visible}
#pre svg.pre-ring ellipse{fill:none;stroke:rgba(255,255,255,.75);stroke-width:1;stroke-dasharray:420;stroke-dashoffset:420}
#pre .mk{width:30px;height:30px;position:absolute}
#pre .ringbox{position:relative;display:grid;place-items:center}
#pre .cnt{font:500 11px/1 var(--mono);letter-spacing:.18em;color:var(--ink3);text-transform:uppercase}
#pre .cnt b{color:var(--ink);font-weight:500;display:inline-block;min-width:3ch;text-align:right}

/* ── nav ── */
.nav{position:fixed;left:0;right:0;top:0;z-index:40;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)}
.nav .in{max-width:var(--maxw);margin:0 auto;height:68px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:28px;padding-left:max(24px,env(safe-area-inset-left,0px));padding-right:max(24px,env(safe-area-inset-right,0px))}
.nav::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:rgba(5,5,6,.78);backdrop-filter:blur(14px) saturate(1.2);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px) saturate(1.2);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);pointer-events:none;transition:background .3s}
.nav.scrolled::before{background:rgba(5,5,6,.9)}
.brand{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font:600 13px/1 var(--sans);letter-spacing:.32em}
.brand svg{width:24px;height:24px}
.nav .links{position:relative;display:flex;gap:26px;font-size:14px;color:var(--ink2)}
.nav .links a:hover{color:var(--ink)}
.nav .right{position:relative;margin-left:auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:20px;font-size:14px;color:var(--ink2)}
.btn{position:relative;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;height:46px;padding:0 22px;border-radius:999px;font:600 15px/1 var(--sans);letter-spacing:.005em;white-space:nowrap;transition:background .2s,color .2s,border-color .2s}
.btn.w{background:#fff;color:#050506}
.btn.w:hover{background:#e6e6ea}
.btn.g{border:1px solid var(--line3);color:var(--ink)}
.btn.g:hover{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.45);background:rgba(255,255,255,.04)}
.btn.sm{height:36px;padding:0 16px;font-size:13.5px}
.btn .ar{transition:transform .25s}
.btn:hover .ar{transform:translateX(3px)}

/* ── common ── */
main{position:relative;z-index:1}
.wrap{max-width:var(--maxw);margin:0 auto;padding-left:max(24px,env(safe-area-inset-left,0px));padding-right:max(24px,env(safe-area-inset-right,0px))}
section{position:relative}
.eyebrow{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin:0 0 22px;font:500 12px/1.3 var(--mono);letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink3)}
.eyebrow .n{color:var(--ink);letter-spacing:.06em}
.eyebrow .bar{width:28px;height:1px;background:var(--line3)}
h2.eyebrow{font-weight:500}
.display{margin:0;font:500 clamp(40px,4.9vw,84px)/1.02 var(--display);letter-spacing:-.042em;text-wrap:balance}
.display em,.story .step h3 em{font-style:normal;color:var(--em)}
/* SplitText masks clip at the line box; give every masked line room for its descenders (Jared: "the font gets cut off") */
.sl,.hl{padding-bottom:.16em;margin-bottom:-.16em}
.lede{margin:26px 0 0;max-width:56ch;font-size:clamp(17px,1.32vw,20px);line-height:1.6;color:var(--ink2);text-wrap:pretty}
.hud{font:500 10.5px/1.2 var(--mono);letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink3)}
.tag{position:absolute;z-index:5;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;padding:6px 10px;border-radius:8px;background:#f3f3f5;color:#050506;font:600 12px/1.2 var(--sans);white-space:nowrap;box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.45);pointer-events:none}
.tag::before{content:"";width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:#050506}
.tag.dk{background:#16161a;color:#f3f3f5;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.14),0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.45)}.tag.dk::before{background:#ff6f6f}
.js:not(.nofx) .tag{opacity:0}
.points{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:40px;margin-top:64px}
.points h3{margin:0 0 8px;font:600 16px/1.35 var(--sans);color:var(--ink)}
.points p{margin:0;font-size:15.5px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--ink2)}
.points .k{display:block;font:500 11px/1 var(--mono);color:var(--ink3);letter-spacing:.12em;margin-bottom:14px}

/* ── Pando window (live HTML UI) ── */
.win{position:relative;background:#0c0d10;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16);border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;color:var(--ink);font:400 12px/1.4 var(--sans);box-shadow:0 60px 140px -30px rgba(0,0,0,.95),0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.6),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.04);text-align:left}
.wt{height:38px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:0 14px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);background:#0d0d10;color:var(--ink2);font-size:12px}
.wt .dots{display:flex;gap:7px}.wt .dots i{width:11px;height:11px;border-radius:50%;background:#26262c}
.wt .cr{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;white-space:nowrap}.wt .cr b{color:var(--ink);font-weight:500}.wt .cr span{color:var(--ink4)}
.wt .sb{margin:0 auto;width:min(34%,330px);height:24px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:0 9px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:7px;color:var(--ink3);font-size:11.5px;background:#0a0a0c}
.wt .sb kbd{margin-left:auto;font:10px/1 var(--mono);color:var(--ink3);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:4px;padding:2px 4px}
.wt .av{width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:50%;background:#26262c;display:grid;place-items:center;font:600 10px/1 var(--sans);color:var(--ink)}
.wb{display:grid;grid-template-columns:46px 232px minmax(0,1fr);height:calc(100% - 38px - 26px)}
.wb.nos{grid-template-columns:46px minmax(0,1fr)}
.rail{border-right:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;padding:12px 0 10px;gap:12px;background:#0a0a0c}
.rail svg.m{width:18px;height:18px}
.rail .ws{width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:7px;background:#1f1f25;display:grid;place-items:center;font:600 10.5px/1 var(--sans);position:relative}
.rail .ws.on::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:-11px;top:6px;width:3px;height:12px;border-radius:2px;background:#fff}
.rail .ws .badge{position:absolute;right:-3px;top:-3px;width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--claude);border:2px solid #0a0a0c}
.rail .plus{color:var(--ink4);font-size:15px;line-height:1}
.rail .nv{margin-top:auto;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;align-items:center}
.rail .nv span{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:3px;font-size:9px;color:var(--ink3)}
.rail .nv span.on{color:var(--ink)}
.rail .nv svg{width:14px;height:14px;stroke:currentColor;fill:none;stroke-width:1.6}
.sd{border-right:1px solid var(--line);padding:12px 12px 0;overflow:hidden;background:#0b0b0e}
.sd .ws-h{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-weight:600;font-size:12.5px;margin-bottom:6px}.sd .ws-h span{color:var(--ink3);font-weight:400;font-size:11px}
.sd h6{margin:14px 0 7px;font:600 9.5px/1 var(--sans);letter-spacing:.09em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink3)}
.sd .it{display:grid;grid-template-columns:18px 1fr auto;gap:2px 8px;padding:6px 6px;border-radius:7px;margin:0 -6px}
.sd .it .b{grid-row:span 3;width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:5px;background:#1e1e24;display:grid;place-items:center;margin-top:1px}
.sd .it .b::after{content:"";width:6px;height:3px;border-radius:2px;background:#cfcfd6;box-shadow:0 -3px 0 -1px #cfcfd6}
.sd .it .t{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--ink);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.sd .it .tm{font-size:10.5px;color:var(--ink3)}
.sd .it .s{grid-column:2/4;font-size:10.5px;color:var(--ink3);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px}
.sd .it .s i{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--ok)}
.sd .it .s.q{color:var(--claude)}
.sd .it .w{grid-column:2/4;font-size:10.5px;color:var(--ink3)}
.sd .it.nu{background:rgba(217,119,87,.06)}
.sd .risk{grid-column:2/4;display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:flex-start;font-size:10.5px;color:var(--ink2);margin-top:3px}
.sd .risk b{font:600 9px/1 var(--mono);letter-spacing:.06em;border:1px solid var(--line3);border-radius:4px;padding:3px 4px;color:var(--ink)}
.sd .acts{grid-column:2/4;display:flex;gap:6px;margin-top:6px}
.mini{height:22px;padding:0 9px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid var(--line2);font:500 10.5px/20px var(--sans);color:var(--ink);background:#141418;display:inline-block}
.mini.w{background:#f3f3f5;color:#0a0a0c;border-color:#f3f3f5}
.panes{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));grid-template-rows:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px;padding:8px;min-width:0;background:#08080a}
.pane{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-width:0;min-height:0;background:#0c0d10;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden}
.pane.nu{border-color:rgba(217,119,87,.7);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(217,119,87,.18)}
.ph{flex:none;height:32px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;padding:0 11px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);font-size:12px;white-space:nowrap;background:#0c0c0f}
.ph .lg{width:14px;height:14px;flex:none;display:grid;place-items:center}
.ph .lg img{width:13px;height:13px}
.ph .lg.cu{border-radius:3px;background:#2a2c31;font:700 8px/1 var(--sans);color:#e6e9ee}
.ph b{font-weight:600}.ph .ag{color:#a6aab4}.ph .task{color:#8f939d;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.st{margin-left:auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:10.5px;color:var(--ink2);flex:none}
.st i{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--ok)}
.st.q{color:var(--claude)}.st.q i{background:var(--claude)}
.st.lim{color:var(--warn)}.st.lim i{background:var(--warn)}
.st .tm{color:var(--ink4)}
.term{flex:1;padding:11px 13px;font:400 12.5px/1.68 var(--mono);color:#d4d7de;white-space:pre-wrap;overflow:hidden;min-height:0}
.term .ln{display:block;min-height:1.7em}
.term .dm{color:#9fa3ad}.term .hi{color:#fff}.term .ok{color:var(--ok)}.term .bd{color:var(--bad)}.term .cl{color:var(--claude)}
.term .cur::after{content:"";display:inline-block;width:7px;height:1.05em;margin-left:2px;vertical-align:-2px;background:#dedee3;animation:blink 1s steps(1) infinite}
@keyframes blink{50%{opacity:0}}
.wf{height:26px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:0 12px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);font-size:10.5px;color:var(--ink3);background:#0a0a0c}
.wf i{display:inline-block;width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--ok);margin-right:6px}
.wf .v{margin-left:auto;color:var(--ink4)}
.hitfx{transition:box-shadow .9s ease}
.hitfx.hit{transition-duration:.16s;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--hc),0 0 0 1px var(--hc),0 0 80px -8px var(--hc)}
.pcur{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;z-index:20;width:22px;height:28px;pointer-events:none;opacity:0;will-change:transform}
.pcur svg{width:100%;height:100%;filter:drop-shadow(0 3px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.6))}
.clk{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:34px;height:34px;margin:-17px 0 0 -17px;border-radius:50%;border:1.5px solid #fff;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:19}

/* ── hero ── */
.hero{padding-top:calc(68px + 7svh);overflow-x:clip}
.hero .top{position:relative;max-width:1360px}
.hero .top h1,.hero .top .slogan,.hero .top .sub,.hero .top .status,.hero .top .fine{text-shadow:0 0 22px rgba(5,5,6,.92),0 0 3px rgba(5,5,6,.9)}
.hero .top::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-30px -60px;background:radial-gradient(closest-side,rgba(5,5,6,.66),rgba(5,5,6,0));z-index:-1;pointer-events:none}
.status{display:flex;gap:24px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:0 0 18px}.status span{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}.status b{color:var(--ink2);font-weight:500}
.status i{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--ok);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(98,209,149,.14)}.status .c i{background:var(--claude);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(217,119,87,.16)}
.hero .sub{margin:26px 0 0;max-width:33em;font-size:clamp(17px,1.35vw,20px);line-height:1.55;color:var(--ink2)}
.slogan{margin:0;font:500 clamp(18px,1.6vw,25px)/1.2 var(--display);color:var(--ink2);letter-spacing:-.01em}
.slogan b{font-weight:500;color:var(--ink)}
h1{margin:.28em 0 0;font:500 clamp(52px,6.9vw,116px)/.96 var(--display);letter-spacing:-.05em}
h1 .l{display:block;text-wrap:balance}
.hero .ctas{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:30px}
.hero .btn{height:50px;padding:0 26px;font-size:15.5px}
.hero .fine{margin:16px 0 0;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--ink3);line-height:1.5}
.hero .fine b{color:var(--ink2);font-weight:500}
.stage{position:relative;max-width:clamp(1000px,86vw,1360px);margin:clamp(34px,5vh,60px) auto 0!important;perspective:1800px}
.stage .win{cursor:zoom-in}
.stage .win::after{content:"Click to explore";position:absolute;right:14px;top:7px;z-index:8;padding:5px 10px;border-radius:999px;background:#f3f3f5;color:#050506;font:600 11.5px/1 var(--display);opacity:0;transform:translateY(-4px);transition:opacity .25s,transform .25s;pointer-events:none}
.stage .win:hover::after{opacity:1;transform:none}
.stage .win{width:100%;aspect-ratio:1200/720;transform-origin:50% 0%}
.stage .cap{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:20px;margin-top:22px;font-size:13px;color:var(--ink3)}
.stage .cap .exp{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.live{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.live::before{content:"";width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--ok);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(98,209,149,.18)}

/* ── band (agent marquee) ── */
.band{padding:110px 0 30px;overflow:hidden}
.band .rowm{display:flex;width:max-content;gap:0;will-change:transform}
.band .rowm .it{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:22px;padding:0 44px;font:500 clamp(48px,6.2vw,104px)/1.1 var(--display);letter-spacing:-.045em;white-space:nowrap;color:var(--ink)}
.band .rowm .it.o{color:transparent;-webkit-text-stroke:1px rgba(255,255,255,.55);font:400 clamp(56px,7.3vw,122px)/1.1 var(--serif);letter-spacing:-.02em}
.band .rowm .it img{width:.6em;height:.6em;flex:none}
.band .rowm .it.o img{opacity:.8}
.band p{margin:44px auto 0;max-width:62ch;text-align:center;color:var(--ink2);font-size:16px}

/* ── side by side ── */
.sec{padding:120px 0}
.head{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,.62fr);gap:56px;align-items:end}
.head .lede{margin-top:0}
.assemble{position:relative;margin-top:64px;perspective:1600px}
.assemble .win{aspect-ratio:1200/470}
.assemble .term{font-size:12.5px}
.assemble .panes{grid-template-rows:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}

/* ── 02 · more than one session, the Preview, what changed ── */
.s2{margin-top:96px}
.pvw{position:relative;margin-top:56px;perspective:1600px}
.pvw .win{aspect-ratio:1200/660}
.pvw .bd2{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:38px;bottom:26px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:46px minmax(0,.9fr) minmax(0,1.1fr)}

Pando is where those agents work: every agent you already pay for in a real terminal, a short plan you approve once, checks that Pando runs itself, Undo for anything you don't want, your yes before anything you can't take back, and one memory they all share.
